Beans don't need much fertilizer since they fix nitrogen from the air, so I will save my money and any fertilizer I have for the maize plot. I have some manure from my animals that I will spread on this field to help the soil. I will plant local bean seed I saved from last season and rely on my family to do the work since the plot is small. We get good rains in Ntchisi, so I don't need to irrigate, and beans usually don't have pests that need chemicals.
